so?#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
smooth_go_attack_params.py

Glättet attack_time_by_midi (t) segmentweise ohne Randbias, leitet daraus g0=1+a*t^2
ab, glättet g0 und berechnet daraus neue curvature_by_midi (a_new). Null-Ränder
werden ignoriert. Schreibt Arrays zurück. Optional Plots.

Beispiel:
  python smooth_go_attack_params.py --input "GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp" --plots ".\\plots" --force
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import re
import os
import sys
from typing import Tuple, List
import numpy as np

# ===================== PATCH: robustere Array-Erkennung =======================

# erlaubt: static / constexpr / const; float|double; 128|0x80; Kommentare usw.
ARRAY_RE = re.compile(
    r"""
    (?P<qual>\b(?:static\s+)?(?:constexpr\s+|const\s+)?)
    (?P<type>float|double)\s+
    (?P<name>curvature_by_midi|attack_time_by_midi)\s*
    \[\s*(?:128|0x80)\s*\]\s*=\s*\{
    (?P<body>.*?)
    \}\s*;
    """,
    re.S | re.M | re.VERBOSE
)

def _strip_comments(s: str) -> str:
    s = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", s, flags=re.S)   # /* ... */
    s = re.sub(r"//.*?$", "", s, flags=re.M)      # // ...
    return s

def _parse_float_list(body: str) -> np.ndarray:
    body = _strip_comments(body)
    parts = [p.strip() for p in body.split(",")]
    vals = []
    for p in parts:
        if not p:
            continue
        p = re.sub(r"(?<=\d)[fF]\b", "", p)   # 0.123f -> 0.123
        p = p.strip(" {};")
        if not p:
            continue
        try:
            vals.append(float(p))
        except ValueError:
            # Ignorieren (z.B. leere Fragmente)
            pass
    return np.array(vals, dtype=float)
    
    # --- generic array finders ---
def _find_array_by_name(text: str, name: str) -> np.ndarray | None:
    """
    Sucht ein C/CPP-Array mit dem gegebenen Namen.
    Größe in den [] ist optional (z.B. [] oder [128] oder [0x80]).
    Typ/Qualifizierer sind egal.
    """
    # Vorverarbeitung: Kommentare raus, damit die { ... }-Suche stabil ist
    text_nc = _strip_comments(text)

    # Regex: <irgendwas wie 'const float'> <name> [optional size] = { ... };
    rx = re.compile(
        rf"""
        (?P<header>
            ^[^\S\r\n]*
            (?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*     # optional qualifiers
            [a-zA-Z_]\w*                           # type token (float/double/auto/...)
            (?:\s+[*&]\s*)*                        # optional pointer/ref
            \s+{re.escape(name)}\s*                # the array name
            \[\s*(?:\d+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*\]\s*   # optional size
            =\s*\{
        )
        (?P<body>.*?)                              # values
        \}\s*;                                     # end
        """,
        re.S | re.M | re.VERBOSE
    )
    m = rx.search(text_nc)
    if not m:
        return None
    arr = _parse_float_list(m.group("body"))
    return arr

def _list_candidate_arrays(text: str) -> list[tuple[str,int]]:
    """
    Listet alle Array-Definitionen (Name, Anzahl parsebarer Floats).
    Hilfreich für --list-arrays.
    """
    text_nc = _strip_comments(text)
    rx_all = re.compile(
        r"""
        ^[^\S\r\n]*
        (?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*     # optional
        [a-zA-Z_]\w*                           # type
        (?:\s+[*&]\s*)*
        \s+([a-zA-Z_]\w*)\s*                   # NAME  <- Gruppe 1
        \[\s*(?:\d+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*\]\s*   # optional size
        =\s*\{(.*?)\}\s*;                      # BODY  <- Gruppe 2
        """,
        re.S | re.M | re.VERBOSE
    )
    out = []
    for m in rx_all.finditer(text_nc):
        name = m.group(1)
        body = m.group(2)
        arr = _parse_float_list(body)
        out.append((name, arr.size))
    return out
# ============================================================================

def parse_cpp_arrays(text: str, name_a: str, name_t: str) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    a = _find_array_by_name(text, name_a)
    t = _find_array_by_name(text, name_t)
    if a is None or t is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Arrays '{name_a}' und/oder '{name_t}' nicht gefunden. "
                         f"Nutze --list-arrays, um alle Kandidaten anzuzeigen.")
    if a.size != 128 or t.size != 128:
        raise ValueError(f"Falsche Längen: {name_a}={a.size}, {name_t}={t.size}. Erwartet jeweils 128.")
    return a, t

def _format_array(name: str, arr: np.ndarray, per_line: int = 16, precision: int = 6) -> str:
    lines = []
    fmt_vals = [f"{v:.{precision}f}" for v in arr]
    for i in range(0, len(fmt_vals), per_line):
        lines.append("  " + ", ".join(fmt_vals[i:i+per_line]))
    body = ",\n".join(lines)
    return f"const float {name}[128] = {{\n{body}\n}};"

def replace_arrays_in_text(text: str, name_a: str, name_t: str,
                           a_new: np.ndarray, t_new: np.ndarray, precision: int) -> str:
    # Ersetze beide Arrays, egal in welcher Reihenfolge sie stehen.
    # Wir bauen neue Definitionen und ersetzen via Regex auf die Namen.
    def _make_re(nm: str):
        return re.compile(
            rf"(?P<qual>\b(?:static\s+)?(?:constexpr\s+|const\s+)?)(?P<type>float|double)\s+{nm}\s*\[\s*(?:128|0x80)\s*\]\s*=\s*\{{.*?\}}\s*;",
            re.S | re.M
        )
    text = re.sub(_make_re(name_a), _format_array(name_a, a_new, precision=precision), text)
    text = re.sub(_make_re(name_t), _format_array(name_t, t_new, precision=precision), text)
    return text

# ------------------------------ Smoothing ------------------------------------

def find_segments(valid_mask: np.ndarray) -> List[tuple[int, int]]:
    idx = np.where(valid_mask.astype(np.int8))[0]
    if idx.size == 0:
        return []
    cuts = np.where(np.diff(idx) > 1)[0]
    starts = np.r_[idx[0], idx[cuts + 1]]
    ends   = np.r_[idx[cuts], idx[-1]] + 1
    return list(zip(starts, ends))

def _hampel_local(x: np.ndarray, k=5, nsig=3.0):
    xo = x.copy()
    n = len(xo)
    for i in range(n):
        i0, i1 = max(0, i - k), min(n, i + k + 1)
        win = xo[i0:i1]
        med = np.median(win)
        mad = np.median(np.abs(win - med)) + 1e-12
        if abs(xo[i] - med) > nsig * 1.4826 * mad:
            xo[i] = 0.5 * xo[i] + 0.5 * med
    return xo

def _moving_average(seg: np.ndarray, w: int):
    r = w // 2
    seg_pad = np.pad(seg, (r, r), mode="edge")
    ker = np.ones(w, dtype=float) / w
    return np.convolve(seg_pad, ker, mode="valid")

def smooth_segmented(y: np.ndarray,
                     valid_mask: np.ndarray,
                     window: int,
                     poly: int,
                     use_savgol: bool = True,
                     pre_hampel: bool = True) -> np.ndarray:
    y_out = y.copy()
    segs = find_segments(valid_mask)
    for (s, e) in segs:
        seg = y[s:e].astype(float)
        if not np.any(np.isfinite(seg)):
            continue
        if pre_hampel:
            seg = _hampel_local(seg, k=5, nsig=3.0)
        L = len(seg)
        w = window if window % 2 == 1 else window + 1
        w = min(max(5, w), L if L % 2 == 1 else L - 1)
        if w < 5:
            y_out[s:e] = seg
            continue
        if use_savgol:
            try:
                from scipy.signal import savgol_filter
                seg_sm = savgol_filter(seg, window_length=w,
                                       polyorder=min(poly, w - 1),
                                       mode="interp")
            except Exception:
                seg_sm = _moving_average(seg, w)
        else:
            seg_sm = _moving_average(seg, w)
        y_out[s:e] = seg_sm
    return y_out

# ------------------------------ Core Logic -----------------------------------

def recompute(a_raw: np.ndarray,
              t_raw: np.ndarray,
              win_t: int,
              win_g0: int,
              poly_t: int,
              poly_g0: int,
              strict_zero_a: bool,
              use_savgol: bool,
              no_hampel: bool) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    valid = (t_raw > 0.0)
    if strict_zero_a:
        valid &= (a_raw != 0.0)

    t_sm = smooth_segmented(
        t_raw, valid, window=win_t, poly=poly_t,
        use_savgol=use_savgol, pre_hampel=(not no_hampel)
    )
    t_sm = np.maximum(t_sm, 0.0)

    g0_raw = 1.0 + a_raw * (t_raw ** 2)
    g0_sm = smooth_segmented(
        g0_raw, valid, window=win_g0, poly=poly_g0,
        use_savgol=use_savgol, pre_hampel=(not no_hampel)
    )
    g0_sm = np.clip(g0_sm, 0.0, 1.0)

    a_new = np.zeros_like(a_raw, dtype=float)
    t2 = t_sm ** 2
    nz = t2 > 0.0
    a_new[nz] = (g0_sm[nz] - 1.0) / t2[nz]
    return a_new, t_sm, g0_raw, g0_sm

# ------------------------------ I/O + Plots ----------------------------------

def maybe_make_dirs(path: str | None):
    if path and path.strip():
        os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)

def save_plots(outdir: str,
               a_raw: np.ndarray, a_new: np.ndarray,
               t_raw: np.ndarray, t_sm: np.ndarray,
               g0_raw: np.ndarray, g0_sm: np.ndarray):
    try:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    except Exception:
        print("[INFO] matplotlib nicht verfügbar – Plots werden übersprungen.")
        return
    maybe_make_dirs(outdir)
    x = np.arange(128)

    plt.figure(); plt.title("attack_time_by_midi")
    plt.plot(x, t_raw, label="t_raw"); plt.plot(x, t_sm, label="t_sm")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("t [s]"); plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, "t_attack.png"), dpi=150); plt.close()

    plt.figure(); plt.title("g0 = 1 + a*t^2")
    plt.plot(x, g0_raw, label="g0_raw"); plt.plot(x, g0_sm, label="g0_sm (smoothed, clamped)")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("g0 [–]"); plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, "g0.png"), dpi=150); plt.close()

    plt.figure(); plt.title("curvature_by_midi")
    plt.plot(x, a_raw, label="a_raw"); plt.plot(x, a_new, label="a_new")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("a [1/s^2]"); plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, "a_curvature.png"), dpi=150); plt.close()

# ------------------------------ Main -----------------------------------------

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Segmentiertes Glätten für GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp")
    ap.add_argument("--input", "-i", required=True, help="Pfad zur C++-Datei mit beiden Arrays")
    ap.add_argument("--out", choices=["same", "new"], default="same",
                    help="'same' = Datei überschreiben (mit .bak), 'new' = _smoothed.cpp daneben schreiben")
    ap.add_argument("--plots", default="", help="Ordner für Plots (optional)")
    ap.add_argument("--sg-window-t",  type=int, default=15, help="Fenster für t (ungerade)")
    ap.add_argument("--sg-window-g0", type=int, default=17, help="Fenster für g0 (ungerade)")
    ap.add_argument("--sg-poly-t",    type=int, default=3,  help="Savitzky-Grad für t")
    ap.add_argument("--sg-poly-g0",   type=int, default=3,  help="Savitzky-Grad für g0")
    ap.add_argument("--no-savgol", action="store_true", help="Savitzky-Golay deaktivieren (nutze Moving Average)")
    ap.add_argument("--no-hampel", action="store_true", help="robuste Hampel-Vordämpfung deaktivieren")
    ap.add_argument("--strict-a-nonzero", action="store_true",
                    help="gültig nur, wenn t>0 UND a!=0 (strengere Randmaske)")
    ap.add_argument("--precision", type=int, default=6, help="Schreibgenauigkeit für C++-Arrays")
    # Kompatibilität:
    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="Kompatibilitäts-Flag (hat hier keine Wirkung)")
    # Falls deine Array-Namen abweichen:
    ap.add_argument("--name-a", default="curvature_by_midi", help="Name des Krümmungs-Arrays")
    ap.add_argument("--name-t", default="attack_time_by_midi", help="Name des Attack-Arrays")
    ap.add_argument("--list-arrays", action="store_true",
                help="Listet alle gefundenen Arrays (Name + Anzahl Werte) und beendet.")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    in_path = args.input
    if not os.path.isfile(in_path):
        print(f"❌ Datei nicht gefunden: {in_path}")
        sys.exit(1)

    text = open(in_path, "r", encoding="utf-8").read()

    if args.list_arrays:
        candidates = _list_candidate_arrays(text)
        if not candidates:
            print("Keine Array-Definitionen gefunden.")
        else:
            print("Gefundene Arrays (Name -> Anzahl Werte):")
            for nm, n in candidates:
                print(f"  {nm:30s} -> {n}")
        sys.exit(0)

    a_new, t_sm, g0_raw, g0_sm = recompute(
        a_raw=a_raw,
        t_raw=t_raw,
        win_t=args.sg_window_t,
        win_g0=args.sg_window_g0,
        poly_t=args.sg_poly_t,
        poly_g0=args.sg_poly_g0,
        strict_zero_a=args.strict_a_nonzero,
        use_savgol=(not args.no_savgol),
        no_hampel=args.no_hampel
    )

    if args.plots:
        save_plots(args.plots, a_raw, a_new, t_raw, t_sm, g0_raw, g0_sm)

    out_text = replace_arrays_in_text(
        text, name_a=args.name_a, name_t=args.name_t,
        a_new=a_new, t_new=t_sm, precision=args.precision
    )

    if args.out == "same":
        bak_path = in_path + ".bak"
        with open(bak_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(text)
        with open(in_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(out_text)
        print(f"✅ Überschrieben: {in_path}\n   Backup: {bak_path}")
    else:
        base, ext = os.path.splitext(in_path)
        out_path = base + "_smoothed" + ext
        with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(out_text)
        print(f"✅ Geschrieben: {out_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
smooth_go_attack_params.py

Glättet attack_time_by_midi (t) segmentweise ohne Randbias, leitet daraus g0=1+a*t^2
ab, glättet g0 und berechnet daraus neue curvature_by_midi (a_new). Null-Ränder
werden ignoriert. Schreibt Arrays zurück. Optional Plots.

Beispiel:
  python smooth_go_attack_params.py --input "GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp" --plots ".\\plots" --force

from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import re
import os
import sys
from typing import Tuple, List
import numpy as np

# ===================== Robuste Array-Finder =======================

def _strip_comments(s: str) -> str:
    s = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", s, flags=re.S)   # /* ... */
    s = re.sub(r"//.*?$", "", s, flags=re.M)      # // ...
    return s

def _parse_float_list(body: str) -> np.ndarray:
    body = _strip_comments(body)
    parts = [p.strip() for p in body.split(",")]
    vals = []
    for p in parts:
        if not p:
            continue
        p = re.sub(r"(?<=\d)[fF]\b", "", p)   # 0.123f -> 0.123
        p = p.strip(" {};")
        if not p:
            continue
        try:
            vals.append(float(p))
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return np.array(vals, dtype=float)

def _find_array_by_name(text: str, name: str) -> np.ndarray | None:
    """
    Sucht ein C/CPP-Array mit dem gegebenen Namen.
    Größe in den [] ist optional (z.B. [] oder [128] oder [0x80]).
    Typ/Qualifizierer sind egal.
    """
    text_nc = _strip_comments(text)
    rx = re.compile(
        rf"""
        (?P<header>
            ^[^\S\r\n]*
            (?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*     
            [a-zA-Z_]\w*                           
            (?:\s+[*&]\s*)*                        
            \s+{re.escape(name)}\s*                
            \[\s*(?:\d+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*\]\s*   
            =\s*\{
        )
        (?P<body>.*?)                              
        \}\s*;                                     
        """,
        re.S | re.M | re.VERBOSE
    )
    m = rx.search(text_nc)
    if not m:
        return None
    return _parse_float_list(m.group("body"))

def _list_candidate_arrays(text: str) -> list[tuple[str,int]]:
    """
    Listet alle Array-Definitionen (Name, Anzahl parsebarer Floats).
    """
    text_nc = _strip_comments(text)
    rx_all = re.compile(
        r"""
        ^[^\S\r\n]*
        (?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*     
        [a-zA-Z_]\w*                           
        (?:\s+[*&]\s*)*
        \s+([a-zA-Z_]\w*)\s*                   
        \[\s*(?:\d+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*\]\s*   
        =\s*\{(.*?)\}\s*;                      
        """,
        re.S | re.M | re.VERBOSE
    )
    out = []
    for m in rx_all.finditer(text_nc):
        name = m.group(1)
        body = m.group(2)
        arr = _parse_float_list(body)
        out.append((name, arr.size))
    return out

def parse_cpp_arrays(text: str, name_a: str, name_t: str) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    a = _find_array_by_name(text, name_a)
    t = _find_array_by_name(text, name_t)
    if a is None or t is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Arrays '{name_a}' und/oder '{name_t}' nicht gefunden. "
                         f"Nutze --list-arrays, um alle Kandidaten anzuzeigen.")
    if a.size != 128 or t.size != 128:
        raise ValueError(f"Falsche Längen: {name_a}={a.size}, {name_t}={t.size}. Erwartet jeweils 128.")
    return a, t

def _format_array(name: str, arr: np.ndarray, per_line: int = 16, precision: int = 6) -> str:
    lines = []
    fmt_vals = [f"{v:.{precision}f}" for v in arr]
    for i in range(0, len(fmt_vals), per_line):
        lines.append("  " + ", ".join(fmt_vals[i:i+per_line]))
    body = ",\n".join(lines)
    return f"const float {name}[128] = {{\n{body}\n}};"

def replace_arrays_in_text(text: str, name_a: str, name_t: str,
                           a_new: np.ndarray, t_new: np.ndarray, precision: int) -> str:
    def _make_re(nm: str):
        return re.compile(
            rf"(?P<qual>\b(?:static\s+)?(?:constexpr\s+|const\s+)?)(?P<type>float|double)\s+{nm}\s*\[\s*(?:128|0x80)\s*\]\s*=\s*\{{.*?\}}\s*;",
            re.S | re.M
        )
    text = re.sub(_make_re(name_a), _format_array(name_a, a_new, precision=precision), text)
    text = re.sub(_make_re(name_t), _format_array(name_t, t_new, precision=precision), text)
    return text

# ===================== Smoothing =======================

def find_segments(valid_mask: np.ndarray) -> List[tuple[int, int]]:
    idx = np.where(valid_mask.astype(np.int8))[0]
    if idx.size == 0:
        return []
    cuts = np.where(np.diff(idx) > 1)[0]
    starts = np.r_[idx[0], idx[cuts + 1]]
    ends   = np.r_[idx[cuts], idx[-1]] + 1
    return list(zip(starts, ends))

def _hampel_local(x: np.ndarray, k=5, nsig=3.0):
    xo = x.copy()
    n = len(xo)
    for i in range(n):
        i0, i1 = max(0, i - k), min(n, i + k + 1)
        win = xo[i0:i1]
        med = np.median(win)
        mad = np.median(np.abs(win - med)) + 1e-12
        if abs(xo[i] - med) > nsig * 1.4826 * mad:
            xo[i] = 0.5 * xo[i] + 0.5 * med
    return xo

def _moving_average(seg: np.ndarray, w: int):
    r = w // 2
    seg_pad = np.pad(seg, (r, r), mode="edge")
    ker = np.ones(w, dtype=float) / w
    return np.convolve(seg_pad, ker, mode="valid")

def smooth_segmented(y: np.ndarray,
                     valid_mask: np.ndarray,
                     window: int,
                     poly: int,
                     use_savgol: bool = True,
                     pre_hampel: bool = True) -> np.ndarray:
    y_out = y.copy()
    segs = find_segments(valid_mask)
    for (s, e) in segs:
        seg = y[s:e].astype(float)
        if not np.any(np.isfinite(seg)):
            continue
        if pre_hampel:
            seg = _hampel_local(seg, k=5, nsig=3.0)
        L = len(seg)
        w = window if window % 2 == 1 else window + 1
        w = min(max(5, w), L if L % 2 == 1 else L - 1)
        if w < 5:
            y_out[s:e] = seg
            continue
        if use_savgol:
            try:
                from scipy.signal import savgol_filter
                seg_sm = savgol_filter(seg, window_length=w,
                                       polyorder=min(poly, w - 1),
                                       mode="interp")
            except Exception:
                seg_sm = _moving_average(seg, w)
        else:
            seg_sm = _moving_average(seg, w)
        y_out[s:e] = seg_sm
    return y_out

# ===================== Core Logic =======================

def recompute(a_raw: np.ndarray,
              t_raw: np.ndarray,
              win_t: int,
              win_g0: int,
              poly_t: int,
              poly_g0: int,
              strict_zero_a: bool,
              use_savgol: bool,
              no_hampel: bool) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    valid = (t_raw > 0.0)
    if strict_zero_a:
        valid &= (a_raw != 0.0)

    t_sm = smooth_segmented(
        t_raw, valid, window=win_t, poly=poly_t,
        use_savgol=use_savgol, pre_hampel=(not no_hampel)
    )
    t_sm = np.maximum(t_sm, 0.0)

    g0_raw = 1.0 + a_raw * (t_raw ** 2)
    g0_sm = smooth_segmented(
        g0_raw, valid, window=win_g0, poly=poly_g0,
        use_savgol=use_savgol, pre_hampel=(not no_hampel)
    )
    g0_sm = np.clip(g0_sm, 0.0, 1.0)

    a_new = np.zeros_like(a_raw, dtype=float)
    t2 = t_sm ** 2
    nz = t2 > 0.0
    a_new[nz] = (g0_sm[nz] - 1.0) / t2[nz]
    return a_new, t_sm, g0_raw, g0_sm

# ===================== I/O + Plots =======================

def maybe_make_dirs(path: str | None):
    if path and path.strip():
        os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)

def save_plots(outdir: str,
               a_raw: np.ndarray, a_new: np.ndarray,
               t_raw: np.ndarray, t_sm: np.ndarray,
               g0_raw: np.ndarray, g0_sm: np.ndarray):
    try:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    except Exception:
        print("[INFO] matplotlib nicht verfügbar – Plots werden übersprungen.")
        return
    maybe_make_dirs(outdir)
    x = np.arange(128)

    plt.figure(); plt.title("attack_time_by_midi")
    plt.plot(x, t_raw, label="t_raw"); plt.plot(x, t_sm, label="t_sm")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("t [s]"); plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, "t_attack.png"), dpi=150); plt.close()

    plt.figure(); plt.title("g0 = 1 + a*t^2")
    plt.plot(x, g0_raw, label="g0_raw"); plt.plot(x, g0_sm, label="g0_sm (smoothed, clamped)")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("g0 [–]"); plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, "g0.png"), dpi=150); plt.close()

    plt.figure(); plt.title("curvature_by_midi")
    plt.plot(x, a_raw, label="a_raw"); plt.plot(x, a_new, label="a_new")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("a [1/s^2]"); plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, "a_curvature.png"), dpi=150); plt.close()

# ===================== Main =======================

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Segmentiertes Glätten für GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp")
    ap.add_argument("--input", "-i", required=True, help="Pfad zur C++-Datei mit beiden Arrays")
    ap.add_argument("--out", choices=["same", "new"], default="same",
                    help="'same' = Datei überschreiben (mit .bak), 'new' = _smoothed.cpp daneben schreiben")

    ap.add_argument("--name-a", default="curvature_by_midi", help="Name des Krümmungs-Arrays")
    ap.add_argument("--name-t", default="attack_time_by_midi", help="Name des Attack-Arrays")
    ap.add_argument("--list-arrays", action="store_true",

    args = ap.parse_args()

    if not os.path.isfile(in_path):

Ah, jetzt ist klar, warum du bei Zeile 65 immer aufläufst:  
Der Fehler `f-string: unmatched ')'` bedeutet, dass der `re.compile(...)`-Block im `_find_array_by_name` nicht sauber in Anführungszeichen abgeschlossen ist.

Das passiert, wenn man ein `rf""" ... """`-Stringliteral hat und die schließenden `"""` **vor** dem schließenden Klammer-Teil nicht richtig setzt.  

So muss der `_find_array_by_name`-Teil aussehen (ich schreibe dir den **sauberen funktionierenden Block**):

```python
def _find_array_by_name(text: str, name: str) -> np.ndarray | None:
    """
    Sucht ein C/CPP-Array mit dem gegebenen Namen.
    Größe in den [] ist optional (z.B. [] oder [128] oder [0x80]).
    Typ/Qualifizierer sind egal.
    """
    text_nc = _strip_comments(text)
    rx = re.compile(
        rf"""
        (?P<header>
            ^[^\S\r\n]*
            (?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*     
            [a-zA-Z_]\w*                           
            (?:\s+[*&]\s*)*                        
            \s+{re.escape(name)}\s*                
            \[\s*(?:\d+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*\]\s*   
            =\s*\{
        )
        (?P<body>.*?)                              
        \}\s*;                                     
        """,   # <--- Triple-Quotes schließen HIER, dann Komma, dann Flags
        re.S | re.M | re.VERBOSE
    )
    m = rx.search(text_nc)
    if not m:
        return None
    return _parse_float_list(m.group("body"))

Ursache: **f-Strings + Regex mit `{`/`}`** → in f-Strings müssen **alle** literalen `{`/`}` verdoppelt werden, sonst crasht der Parser („unmatched ')'“ ist hier eine irreführende Folgeerscheinung). Ich habe das jetzt sauber gelöst, indem ich **alle f-Strings in den Regexen entfernt** und durch **String‑Konkatenation** ersetzt habe. Das ist bulletproof.

Hier ist das **komplette, korrigierte Listing** – 1:1 reinkopieren:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
smooth_go_attack_params.py

Glättet attack_time_by_midi (t) segmentweise ohne Randbias, leitet daraus g0=1+a*t^2
ab, glättet g0 und berechnet daraus neue curvature_by_midi (a_new). Null-Ränder
werden ignoriert. Schreibt Arrays zurück. Optional Plots.

Beispiel:
  python smooth_go_attack_params.py --input "GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp" --plots ".\\plots" --force
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import re
import os
import sys
from typing import Tuple, List
import numpy as np

# ===================== Robuste Array-Finder =======================

def _strip_comments(s: str) -> str:
    s = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", s, flags=re.S)   # /* ... */
    s = re.sub(r"//.*?$", "", s, flags=re.M)      # // ...
    return s

def _parse_float_list(body: str) -> np.ndarray:
    body = _strip_comments(body)
    parts = [p.strip() for p in body.split(",")]
    vals = []
    for p in parts:
        if not p:
            continue
        p = re.sub(r"(?<=\d)[fF]\b", "", p)   # 0.123f -> 0.123
        p = p.strip(" {};")
        if not p:
            continue
        try:
            vals.append(float(p))
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return np.array(vals, dtype=float)

def _find_array_by_name(text: str, name: str) -> np.ndarray | None:
    """
    Sucht ein C/CPP-Array mit dem gegebenen Namen.
    Größe in den [] ist optional (z.B. [] oder [128] oder [0x80]).
    Typ/Qualifizierer sind egal.
    """
    text_nc = _strip_comments(text)
    pat = (
        r"""
        (?P<header>
            ^[^\S\r\n]*
            (?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*     
            [a-zA-Z_]\w*                           
            (?:\s+[*&]\s*)*                        
            \s+""" + re.escape(name) + r"""\s*                
            \[\s*(?:\d+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*\]\s*   
            =\s*\{
        )
        (?P<body>.*?)                              
        \}\s*;                                     
        """
    )
    rx = re.compile(pat, re.S | re.M | re.VERBOSE)
    m = rx.search(text_nc)
    if not m:
        return None
    return _parse_float_list(m.group("body"))

def _list_candidate_arrays(text: str) -> List[Tuple[str,int]]:
    """
    Listet alle Array-Definitionen (Name, Anzahl parsebarer Floats).
    """
    text_nc = _strip_comments(text)
    rx_all = re.compile(
        r"""
        ^[^\S\r\n]*
        (?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*     
        [a-zA-Z_]\w*                           
        (?:\s+[*&]\s*)*
        \s+([a-zA-Z_]\w*)\s*                   
        \[\s*(?:\d+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*\]\s*   
        =\s*\{(.*?)\}\s*;                      
        """,
        re.S | re.M | re.VERBOSE
    )
    out: List[Tuple[str,int]] = []
    for m in rx_all.finditer(text_nc):
        name = m.group(1)
        body = m.group(2)
        arr = _parse_float_list(body)
        out.append((name, arr.size))
    return out

def parse_cpp_arrays(text: str, name_a: str, name_t: str) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    a = _find_array_by_name(text, name_a)
    t = _find_array_by_name(text, name_t)
    if a is None or t is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Arrays '{name_a}' und/oder '{name_t}' nicht gefunden. "
                         f"Nutze --list-arrays, um alle Kandidaten anzuzeigen.")
    if a.size != 128 or t.size != 128:
        raise ValueError(f"Falsche Längen: {name_a}={a.size}, {name_t}={t.size}. Erwartet jeweils 128.")
    return a, t

def _format_array(name: str, arr: np.ndarray, per_line: int = 16, precision: int = 6) -> str:
    lines = []
    fmt_vals = [f"{v:.{precision}f}" for v in arr]
    for i in range(0, len(fmt_vals), per_line):
        lines.append("  " + ", ".join(fmt_vals[i:i+per_line]))
    body = ",\n".join(lines)
    return f"const float {name}[128] = {{\n{body}\n}};"

def replace_arrays_in_text(text: str, name_a: str, name_t: str,
                           a_new: np.ndarray, t_new: np.ndarray, precision: int) -> str:
    def _make_re(nm: str):
        pat = (
            r"(?P<qual>\b(?:static\s+)?(?:constexpr\s+|const\s+)?)"
            r"(?P<type>float|double)\s+" + re.escape(nm) + r"\s*"
            r"\[\s*(?:128|0x80)\s*\]\s*=\s*\{.*?\}\s*;"
        )
        return re.compile(pat, re.S | re.M)
    text = re.sub(_make_re(name_a), _format_array(name_a, a_new, precision=precision), text)
    text = re.sub(_make_re(name_t), _format_array(name_t, t_new, precision=precision), text)
    return text

# ===================== Smoothing =======================

def find_segments(valid_mask: np.ndarray) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]:
    idx = np.where(valid_mask.astype(np.int8))[0]
    if idx.size == 0:
        return []
    cuts = np.where(np.diff(idx) > 1)[0]
    starts = np.r_[idx[0], idx[cuts + 1]]
    ends   = np.r_[idx[cuts], idx[-1]] + 1
    return list(zip(starts, ends))

def _hampel_local(x: np.ndarray, k=5, nsig=3.0):
    xo = x.copy()
    n = len(xo)
    for i in range(n):
        i0, i1 = max(0, i - k), min(n, i + k + 1)
        win = xo[i0:i1]
        med = np.median(win)
        mad = np.median(np.abs(win - med)) + 1e-12
        if abs(xo[i] - med) > nsig * 1.4826 * mad:
            xo[i] = 0.5 * xo[i] + 0.5 * med
    return xo

def _moving_average(seg: np.ndarray, w: int):
    r = w // 2
    seg_pad = np.pad(seg, (r, r), mode="edge")
    ker = np.ones(w, dtype=float) / w
    return np.convolve(seg_pad, ker, mode="valid")

def smooth_segmented(y: np.ndarray,
                     valid_mask: np.ndarray,
                     window: int,
                     poly: int,
                     use_savgol: bool = True,
                     pre_hampel: bool = True) -> np.ndarray:
    y_out = y.copy()
    segs = find_segments(valid_mask)
    for (s, e) in segs:
        seg = y[s:e].astype(float)
        if not np.any(np.isfinite(seg)):
            continue
        if pre_hampel:
            seg = _hampel_local(seg, k=5, nsig=3.0)
        L = len(seg)
        w = window if window % 2 == 1 else window + 1
        w = min(max(5, w), L if L % 2 == 1 else L - 1)
        if w < 5:
            y_out[s:e] = seg
            continue
        if use_savgol:
            try:
                from scipy.signal import savgol_filter
                seg_sm = savgol_filter(seg, window_length=w,
                                       polyorder=min(poly, w - 1),
                                       mode="interp")
            except Exception:
                seg_sm = _moving_average(seg, w)
        else:
            seg_sm = _moving_average(seg, w)
        y_out[s:e] = seg_sm
    return y_out

# ===================== Core Logic =======================

def recompute(a_raw: np.ndarray,
              t_raw: np.ndarray,
              win_t: int,
              win_g0: int,
              poly_t: int,
              poly_g0: int,
              strict_zero_a: bool,
              use_savgol: bool,
              no_hampel: bool) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    valid = (t_raw > 0.0)
    if strict_zero_a:
        valid &= (a_raw != 0.0)

    t_sm = smooth_segmented(
        t_raw, valid, window=win_t, poly=poly_t,
        use_savgol=use_savgol, pre_hampel=(not no_hampel)
    )
    t_sm = np.maximum(t_sm, 0.0)

    g0_raw = 1.0 + a_raw * (t_raw ** 2)
    g0_sm = smooth_segmented(
        g0_raw, valid, window=win_g0, poly=poly_g0,
        use_savgol=use_savgol, pre_hampel=(not no_hampel)
    )
    g0_sm = np.clip(g0_sm, 0.0, 1.0)

    a_new = np.zeros_like(a_raw, dtype=float)
    t2 = t_sm ** 2
    nz = t2 > 0.0
    a_new[nz] = (g0_sm[nz] - 1.0) / t2[nz]
    return a_new, t_sm, g0_raw, g0_sm

# ===================== I/O + Plots =======================

def maybe_make_dirs(path: str | None):
    if path and path.strip():
        os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)

def save_plots(outdir: str,
               a_raw: np.ndarray, a_new: np.ndarray,
               t_raw: np.ndarray, t_sm: np.ndarray,
               g0_raw: np.ndarray, g0_sm: np.ndarray):
    try:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    except Exception:
        print("[INFO] matplotlib nicht verfügbar – Plots werden übersprungen.")
        return
    maybe_make_dirs(outdir)
    x = np.arange(128)

    plt.figure(); plt.title("attack_time_by_midi")
    plt.plot(x, t_raw, label="t_raw"); plt.plot(x, t_sm, label="t_sm")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("t [s]"); plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, "t_attack.png"), dpi=150); plt.close()

    plt.figure(); plt.title("g0 = 1 + a*t^2")
    plt.plot(x, g0_raw, label="g0_raw"); plt.plot(x, g0_sm, label="g0_sm (smoothed, clamped)")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("g0 [–]"); plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, "g0.png"), dpi=150); plt.close()

    plt.figure(); plt.title("curvature_by_midi")
    plt.plot(x, a_raw, label="a_raw"); plt.plot(x, a_new, label="a_new")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("a [1/s^2]"); plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, "a_curvature.png"), dpi=150); plt.close()

# ===================== Main =======================

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Segmentiertes Glätten für GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp")
    ap.add_argument("--input", "-i", required=True, help="Pfad zur C++-Datei mit beiden Arrays")
    ap.add_argument("--out", choices=["same", "new"], default="same",
                    help="'same' = Datei überschreiben (mit .bak), 'new' = _smoothed.cpp daneben schreiben")
    ap.add_argument("--plots", default="", help="Ordner für Plots (optional)")
    ap.add_argument("--sg-window-t",  type=int, default=15, help="Fenster für t (ungerade)")
    ap.add_argument("--sg-window-g0", type=int, default=17, help="Fenster für g0 (ungerade)")
    ap.add_argument("--sg-poly-t",    type=int, default=3,  help="Savitzky-Grad für t")
    ap.add_argument("--sg-poly-g0",   type=int, default=3,  help="Savitzky-Grad für g0")
    ap.add_argument("--no-savgol", action="store_true", help="Savitzky-Golay deaktivieren (nutze Moving Average)")
    ap.add_argument("--no-hampel", action="store_true", help="robuste Hampel-Vordämpfung deaktivieren")
    ap.add_argument("--strict-a-nonzero", action="store_true",
                    help="gültig nur, wenn t>0 UND a!=0 (strengere Randmaske)")
    ap.add_argument("--precision", type=int, default=6, help="Schreibgenauigkeit für C++-Arrays")
    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="Kompatibilitäts-Flag (hat hier keine Wirkung)")
    ap.add_argument("--name-a", default="curvature_by_midi", help="Name des Krümmungs-Arrays")
    ap.add_argument("--name-t", default="attack_time_by_midi", help="Name des Attack-Arrays")
    ap.add_argument("--list-arrays", action="store_true",
                    help="Listet alle gefundenen Arrays (Name + Anzahl Werte) und beendet.")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    in_path = args.input
    if not os.path.isfile(in_path):
        print(f"❌ Datei nicht gefunden: {in_path}")
        sys.exit(1)

    text = open(in_path, "r", encoding="utf-8").read()

    if args.list_arrays:
        candidates = _list_candidate_arrays(text)
        if not candidates:
            print("Keine Array-Definitionen gefunden.")
        else:
            print("Gefundene Arrays (Name -> Anzahl Werte):")
            for nm, n in candidates:
                print(f"  {nm:30s} -> {n}")
        sys.exit(0)

    a_raw, t_raw = parse_cpp_arrays(text, name_a=args.name_a, name_t=args.name_t)

    a_new, t_sm, g0_raw, g0_sm = recompute(
        a_raw=a_raw,
        t_raw=t_raw,

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
smooth_go_attack_params.py  (One‑Shot Multi‑Channel)

Findet automatisch Paare von Arrays der Form:
  - curvature_<channel>_by_midi[128] = {...};
  - attack_time_<channel>_by_midi[128] = {...};
und verarbeitet ALLE gefundenen Kanäle in EINEM Lauf (z. B. dry/front/rear).

Glättet attack_time (t) segmentweise ohne Randbias, leitet daraus g0=1+a*t^2 ab,
glättet g0 (clamp 0..1) und berechnet neue curvature (a_new). Schreibt pro Kanal
die geglätteten t und die neuen a zurück. Optional Plots pro Kanal.

Beispiele:
  python smooth_go_attack_params.py -i "GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp" --plots ".\\plots" --force
  # Nur bestimmte Kanäle:
  python smooth_go_attack_params.py -i "GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp" --channels dry,front

Hinweis:
- Ränder (t==0, optional a==0) werden beim Glätten segmentweise ignoriert.
- SciPy ist optional; ohne SciPy wird Moving Average genutzt.
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import os
import re
import sys
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
import numpy as np


# ===================== Utilities: Parsing & Replacement =======================

def _strip_comments(s: str) -> str:
    s = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", s, flags=re.S)   # /* ... */
    s = re.sub(r"//.*?$", "", s, flags=re.M)      # // ...
    return s

def _parse_float_list(body: str) -> np.ndarray:
    body = _strip_comments(body)
    parts = [p.strip() for p in body.split(",")]
    vals: List[float] = []
    for p in parts:
        if not p:
            continue
        p = re.sub(r"(?<=\d)[fF]\b", "", p)   # 0.123f -> 0.123
        p = p.strip(" {};")
        if not p:
            continue
        try:
            vals.append(float(p))
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return np.array(vals, dtype=float)

def _find_array_by_exact_name(text: str, name: str) -> Tuple[np.ndarray | None, Tuple[int,int] | None]:
    """
    Sucht ein C/CPP-Array mit GENAU diesem Namen (unabhängig von Typ/Qualifizierern).
    Return: (array_values_or_None, (start_idx, end_idx) des gesamten Array-Textes)  end_idx exklusiv
    """
    text_nc = _strip_comments(text)
    pat = (
        r"(^[^\S\r\n]*"
        r"(?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*"
        r"[a-zA-Z_]\w*"
        r"(?:\s+[*&]\s*)*"
        r"\s+" + re.escape(name) + r"\s*"
        r"\[\s*(?:\d+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*\]\s*=\s*\{)"
        r"(.*?)"
        r"(\}\s*;)"
    )
    rx = re.compile(pat, re.S | re.M)
    m = rx.search(text_nc)
    if not m:
        return None, None
    body = m.group(2)
    arr = _parse_float_list(body)
    # Finde dieselbe Stelle im Originaltext (mit Kommentaren) für robustes Ersetzen:
    # Wir suchen über einen weniger strengen Header (ohne Kommentare) und matchen erneut im Original.
    header_rough = m.group(1)
    trailer = m.group(3)
    # Baue Suchregex für Originaltext ohne f-String:
    rx_orig = re.compile(re.escape(header_rough) + r".*?" + re.escape(trailer), re.S | re.M)
    m2 = rx_orig.search(_strip_comments(text))  # Positionen in comment-stripped Text
    if not m2:
        # Fallback: wir suchen im Originaltext via weniger restriktivem Pattern
        rx_orig2 = re.compile(
            r"(^[^\S\r\n]*(?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*[a-zA-Z_]\w*(?:\s+[*&]\s*)*\s+"
            + re.escape(name) + r"\s*\[\s*(?:\d+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*\]\s*=\s*\{.*?\}\s*;)",
            re.S | re.M
        )
        m3 = rx_orig2.search(text)
        if not m3:
            return arr, None
        return arr, (m3.start(1), m3.end(1))
    # Wir müssen die Position im Originaltext finden; Mapping zwischen stripped/original ist schwierig.
    # Praktischer Weg: noch einmal im ORIGINAL mit ähnlichem Regex suchen:
    rx_final = re.compile(
        r"(^[^\S\r\n]*(?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*[a-zA-Z_]\w*(?:\s+[*&]\s*)*\s+"
        + re.escape(name) + r"\s*\[\s*(?:\d+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*\]\s*=\s*\{)"
        + r"(.*?)"
        + r"(\}\s*;)",
        re.S | re.M
    )
    m4 = rx_final.search(text)
    if not m4:
        return arr, None
    return arr, (m4.start(0), m4.end(0))

def _format_array(name: str, arr: np.ndarray, per_line: int = 16, precision: int = 6) -> str:
    lines: List[str] = []
    fmt_vals = [f"{v:.{precision}f}" for v in arr]
    for i in range(0, len(fmt_vals), per_line):
        lines.append("  " + ", ".join(fmt_vals[i:i+per_line]))
    body = ",\n".join(lines)
    return f"const float {name}[128] = {{\n{body}\n}};"

def _replace_array_by_name(text: str, name: str, new_array_text: str) -> str:
    rx = re.compile(
        r"(^[^\S\r\n]*(?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*[a-zA-Z_]\w*(?:\s+[*&]\s*)*\s+"
        + re.escape(name) + r"\s*\[\s*(?:128|0x80)\s*\]\s*=\s*\{.*?\}\s*;)",
        re.S | re.M
    )
    return rx.sub(new_array_text, text, count=1)

def _discover_channel_pairs(text: str) -> List[Tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """
    Findet alle (channel, a_name, t_name) anhand des Namensschemas:
      curvature_<channel>_by_midi  &  attack_time_<channel>_by_midi
    Gibt Liste mit eindeutigen Channels zurück.
    """
    names: List[str] = []
    text_nc = _strip_comments(text)
    # Liste alle Array-Namen:
    rx_all = re.compile(
        r"^[^\S\r\n]*(?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*[a-zA-Z_]\w*(?:\s+[*&]\s*)*\s+([a-zA-Z_]\w*)\s*\[\s*(?:\d+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*\]\s*=\s*\{",
        re.S | re.M
    )
    for m in rx_all.finditer(text_nc):
        names.append(m.group(1))
    channels: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
    for nm in names:
        if nm.startswith("curvature_") and nm.endswith("_by_midi"):
            tail = nm[len("curvature_"):-len("_by_midi")]
            channels.setdefault(tail, {})["a"] = nm
        elif nm.startswith("attack_time_") and nm.endswith("_by_midi"):
            tail = nm[len("attack_time_"):-len("_by_midi")]
            channels.setdefault(tail, {})["t"] = nm
    out: List[Tuple[str, str, str]] = []
    for tail, d in channels.items():
        if "a" in d and "t" in d:
            out.append((tail, d["a"], d["t"]))
    return out


# ===================== Smoothing (segmentweise) =======================

def find_segments(valid_mask: np.ndarray) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]:
    idx = np.where(valid_mask.astype(np.int8))[0]
    if idx.size == 0:
        return []
    cuts = np.where(np.diff(idx) > 1)[0]
    starts = np.r_[idx[0], idx[cuts + 1]]
    ends   = np.r_[idx[cuts], idx[-1]] + 1
    return list(zip(starts, ends))

def _hampel_local(x: np.ndarray, k=5, nsig=3.0):
    xo = x.copy()
    n = len(xo)
    for i in range(n):
        i0, i1 = max(0, i - k), min(n, i + k + 1)
        win = xo[i0:i1]
        med = np.median(win)
        mad = np.median(np.abs(win - med)) + 1e-12
        if abs(xo[i] - med) > nsig * 1.4826 * mad:
            xo[i] = 0.5 * xo[i] + 0.5 * med
    return xo

def _moving_average(seg: np.ndarray, w: int):
    r = w // 2
    seg_pad = np.pad(seg, (r, r), mode="edge")
    ker = np.ones(w, dtype=float) / w
    return np.convolve(seg_pad, ker, mode="valid")

def smooth_segmented(y: np.ndarray,
                     valid_mask: np.ndarray,
                     window: int,
                     poly: int,
                     use_savgol: bool = True,
                     pre_hampel: bool = True) -> np.ndarray:
    y_out = y.copy()
    segs = find_segments(valid_mask)
    for (s, e) in segs:
        seg = y[s:e].astype(float)
        if not np.any(np.isfinite(seg)):
            continue
        if pre_hampel:
            seg = _hampel_local(seg, k=5, nsig=3.0)
        L = len(seg)
        w = window if window % 2 == 1 else window + 1
        w = min(max(5, w), L if L % 2 == 1 else L - 1)
        if w < 5:
            y_out[s:e] = seg
            continue
        if use_savgol:
            try:
                from scipy.signal import savgol_filter  # optional
                seg_sm = savgol_filter(seg, window_length=w,
                                       polyorder=min(poly, w - 1),
                                       mode="interp")
            except Exception:
                seg_sm = _moving_average(seg, w)
        else:
            seg_sm = _moving_average(seg, w)
        y_out[s:e] = seg_sm
    return y_out


# ===================== Core: Recompute per channel =======================

def recompute_channel(a_raw: np.ndarray,
                      t_raw: np.ndarray,
                      win_t: int,
                      win_g0: int,
                      poly_t: int,
                      poly_g0: int,
                      strict_zero_a: bool,
                      use_savgol: bool,
                      no_hampel: bool) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    valid = (t_raw > 0.0)
    if strict_zero_a:
        valid &= (a_raw != 0.0)

    t_sm = smooth_segmented(
        t_raw, valid, window=win_t, poly=poly_t,
        use_savgol=use_savgol, pre_hampel=(not no_hampel)
    )
    t_sm = np.maximum(t_sm, 0.0)

    g0_raw = 1.0 + a_raw * (t_raw ** 2)
    g0_sm = smooth_segmented(
        g0_raw, valid, window=win_g0, poly=poly_g0,
        use_savgol=use_savgol, pre_hampel=(not no_hampel)
    )
    g0_sm = np.clip(g0_sm, 0.0, 1.0)

    a_new = np.zeros_like(a_raw, dtype=float)
    t2 = t_sm ** 2
    nz = t2 > 0.0
    a_new[nz] = (g0_sm[nz] - 1.0) / t2[nz]
    return a_new, t_sm, g0_raw, g0_sm


# ===================== Plots =======================

def maybe_make_dirs(path: str | None):
    if path and path.strip():
        os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)

def save_plots(outdir: str,
               channel: str,
               a_raw: np.ndarray, a_new: np.ndarray,
               t_raw: np.ndarray, t_sm: np.ndarray,
               g0_raw: np.ndarray, g0_sm: np.ndarray):
    try:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # optional
    except Exception:
        print(f"[INFO] matplotlib nicht verfügbar – Plots für '{channel}' werden übersprungen.")
        return
    d = os.path.join(outdir, channel) if outdir else ""
    if d:
        maybe_make_dirs(d)
    x = np.arange(128)

    # t
    plt.figure()
    plt.title(f"{channel}: attack_time_by_midi")
    plt.plot(x, t_raw, label="t_raw")
    plt.plot(x, t_sm, label="t_sm")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("t [s]")
    plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout()
    if d: plt.savefig(os.path.join(d, "t_attack.png"), dpi=150)
    plt.close()

    # g0
    plt.figure()
    plt.title(f"{channel}: g0 = 1 + a*t^2")
    plt.plot(x, g0_raw, label="g0_raw")
    plt.plot(x, g0_sm, label="g0_sm (smoothed, clamped)")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("g0 [–]")
    plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout()
    if d: plt.savefig(os.path.join(d, "g0.png"), dpi=150)
    plt.close()

    # a
    plt.figure()
    plt.title(f"{channel}: curvature_by_midi")
    plt.plot(x, a_raw, label="a_raw")
    plt.plot(x, a_new, label="a_new")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("a [1/s^2]")
    plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout()
    if d: plt.savefig(os.path.join(d, "a_curvature.png"), dpi=150)
    plt.close()


# ===================== Main =======================

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="One‑Shot: segmentiertes Glätten für alle <channel>-Paare in GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp")
    ap.add_argument("--input", "-i", required=True, help="Pfad zur C++‑Datei mit den Arrays")
    ap.add_argument("--out", choices=["same", "new"], default="same",
                    help="'same' = Datei überschreiben (mit .bak), 'new' = _smoothed.cpp daneben schreiben")
    ap.add_argument("--plots", default="", help="Ordner für Plots (optional; pro Kanal Unterordner)")
    ap.add_argument("--channels", default="", help="Kommagetrennte Kanäle (z. B. 'dry,front'); leer = automatisch alle Paare")
    ap.add_argument("--sg-window-t",  type=int, default=15, help="Fenster für t (ungerade)")
    ap.add_argument("--sg-window-g0", type=int, default=17, help="Fenster für g0 (ungerade)")
    ap.add_argument("--sg-poly-t",    type=int, default=3,  help="Savitzky‑Grad für t")
    ap.add_argument("--sg-poly-g0",   type=int, default=3,  help="Savitzky‑Grad für g0")
    ap.add_argument("--no-savgol", action="store_true", help="Savitzky‑Golay deaktivieren (nutze Moving Average)")
    ap.add_argument("--no-hampel", action="store_true", help="robuste Hampel‑Vordämpfung deaktivieren")
    ap.add_argument("--strict-a-nonzero", action="store_true",
                    help="gültig nur, wenn t>0 UND a!=0 (strengere Randmaske)")
    ap.add_argument("--precision", type=int, default=6, help="Schreibgenauigkeit für C++‑Arrays")
    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="Kompatibilitäts‑Flag (hat hier keine besondere Wirkung)")
    ap.add_argument("--list-arrays", action="store_true", help="Listet alle gefundenen Arrays (Name + Anzahl Werte) und beendet.")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    in_path = args.input
    if not os.path.isfile(in_path):
        print(f"❌ Datei nicht gefunden: {in_path}")
        sys.exit(1)

    text = open(in_path, "r", encoding="utf-8").read()

    # Debug: Arrays auflisten
    if args.list_arrays:
        pairs = _discover_channel_pairs(text)
        if not pairs:
            print("Keine passenden (curvature_/attack_time_) Paare gefunden.")
        else:
            print("Gefundene Kanäle:")
            for ch, a_name, t_name in pairs:
                print(f"  {ch:10s}  a={a_name:30s}  t={t_name}")
        sys.exit(0)

    # 1) Paare entdecken
    pairs = _discover_channel_pairs(text)
    if not pairs:
        print("❌ Keine (curvature_<channel>_by_midi / attack_time_<channel>_by_midi) Paare gefunden.")
        sys.exit(2)

    # 2) Optional: Kanäle filtern
    if args.channels.strip():
        wanted = {c.strip() for c in args.channels.split(",") if c.strip()}
        pairs = [p for p in pairs if p[0] in wanted]
        if not pairs:
            print(f"❌ Keine der gewünschten Kanäle gefunden: {sorted(wanted)}")
            sys.exit(3)

    # 3) Pro Kanal lesen, rechnen, sammeln
    results: Dict[str, Dict[str, np.ndarray]] = {}
    for channel, a_name, t_name in pairs:
        a_vals, _span_a = _find_array_by_exact_name(text, a_name)
        t_vals, _span_t = _find_array_by_exact_name(text, t_name)
        if a_vals is None or t_vals is None:
            print(f"[WARN] Kanal '{channel}': Arrays nicht vollständig gefunden; übersprungen.")
            continue
        if a_vals.size != 128 or t_vals.size != 128:
            print(f"[WARN] Kanal '{channel}': Array‑Längen sind nicht 128; übersprungen.")
            continue

        a_new, t_sm, g0_raw, g0_sm = recompute_channel(
            a_raw=a_vals,
            t_raw=t_vals,
            win_t=args.sg_window_t,
            win_g0=args.sg_window_g0,
            poly_t=args.sg_poly_t,
            poly_g0=args.sg_poly_g0,
            strict_zero_a=args.strict_a_nonzero,
            use_savgol=(not args.no_savgol),
            no_hampel=args.no_hampel
        )

        results[channel] = {
            "a_name": a_name, "t_name": t_name,
            "a_raw": a_vals, "t_raw": t_vals,
            "a_new": a_new,  "t_sm": t_sm,
            "g0_raw": g0_raw, "g0_sm": g0_sm,
        }

        if args.plots:
            save_plots(args.plots, channel, a_vals, a_new, t_vals, t_sm, g0_raw, g0_sm)

    if not results:
        print("❌ Keine Kanäle verarbeitet.")
        sys.exit(4)

    # 4) Einmaliges Schreiben: alle betroffenen Arrays ersetzen
    out_text = text
    for ch, data in results.items():
        out_text = _replace_array_by_name(out_text, data["a_name"], _format_array(data["a_name"], data["a_new"], precision=args.precision))
        out_text = _replace_array_by_name(out_text, data["t_name"], _format_array(data["t_name"], data["t_sm"],  precision=args.precision))

    # 5) Ausgabe
    if args.out == "same":
        bak_path = in_path + ".bak"
        with open(bak_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(text)
        with open(in_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(out_text)
        print(f"✅ Überschrieben: {in_path}\n   Backup: {bak_path}")
    else:
        base, ext = os.path.splitext(in_path)
        out_path = base + "_smoothed" + ext
        with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(out_text)
        print(f"✅ Geschrieben: {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

Hier ist das **komplette One‑Shot‑Listing** mit **Ausreißer‑Ersetzung (Standard: AN)**, segmentweisem Glätten und Multi‑Channel‑Support:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
smooth_go_attack_params.py  (One‑Shot Multi‑Channel)

Findet automatisch Paare von Arrays der Form:
  - curvature_<channel>_by_midi[128] = {...};
  - attack_time_<channel>_by_midi[128] = {...};
und verarbeitet ALLE gefundenen Kanäle in EINEM Lauf (z. B. dry/front/rear).

Pipeline je Kanal:
  t_sm = smooth_segmented(t, outlier_replace)         # segmentweise, Rand-0 ignoriert
  g0_raw = 1 + a * t^2
  g0_sm = smooth_segmented(g0_raw, outlier_replace)   # clamp 0..1
  a_new = (g0_sm - 1) / t_sm^2  (nur wo t_sm>0)

Schreibt t_sm und a_new zurück. Optional Plots pro Kanal.

Beispiele:
  python smooth_go_attack_params.py -i "GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp" --plots ".\\plots" --force
  python smooth_go_attack_params.py -i "GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp" --channels dry,front
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import os
import re
import sys
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
import numpy as np


# ===================== Utilities: Parsing & Replacement =======================

def _strip_comments(s: str) -> str:
    s = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", s, flags=re.S)   # /* ... */
    s = re.sub(r"//.*?$", "", s, flags=re.M)      # // ...
    return s

def _parse_float_list(body: str) -> np.ndarray:
    body = _strip_comments(body)
    parts = [p.strip() for p in body.split(",")]
    vals: List[float] = []
    for p in parts:
        if not p:
            continue
        p = re.sub(r"(?<=\d)[fF]\b", "", p)   # 0.123f -> 0.123
        p = p.strip(" {};")
        if not p:
            continue
        try:
            vals.append(float(p))
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return np.array(vals, dtype=float)

def _find_array_by_exact_name(text: str, name: str) -> Tuple[np.ndarray | None, Tuple[int,int] | None]:
    """
    Sucht ein C/CPP-Array mit GENAU diesem Namen (unabhängig von Typ/Qualifizierern).
    Return: (array_values_or_None, (start_idx, end_idx) des gesamten Array-Textes)  end_idx exklusiv
    """
    text_nc = _strip_comments(text)
    pat = (
        r"(^[^\S\r\n]*"
        r"(?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*"
        r"[a-zA-Z_]\w*"
        r"(?:\s+[*&]\s*)*"
        r"\s+" + re.escape(name) + r"\s*"
        r"\[\s*(?:\d+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*\]\s*=\s*\{)"
        r"(.*?)"
        r"(\}\s*;)"
    )
    rx = re.compile(pat, re.S | re.M)
    m = rx.search(text_nc)
    if not m:
        return None, None
    body = m.group(2)
    arr = _parse_float_list(body)
    # Erneut im ORIGINAL suchen, um die exakten Grenzen zu bekommen:
    rx_final = re.compile(
        r"(^[^\S\r\n]*(?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*[a-zA-Z_]\w*(?:\s+[*&]\s*)*\s+"
        + re.escape(name) + r"\s*\[\s*(?:\d+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*\]\s*=\s*\{)"
        + r"(.*?)"
        + r"(\}\s*;)",
        re.S | re.M
    )
    m4 = rx_final.search(text)
    if not m4:
        return arr, None
    return arr, (m4.start(0), m4.end(0))

def _format_array(name: str, arr: np.ndarray, per_line: int = 16, precision: int = 6) -> str:
    lines: List[str] = []
    fmt_vals = [f"{v:.{precision}f}" for v in arr]
    for i in range(0, len(fmt_vals), per_line):
        lines.append("  " + ", ".join(fmt_vals[i:i+per_line]))
    body = ",\n".join(lines)
    return f"const float {name}[128] = {{\n{body}\n}};"

def _replace_array_by_name(text: str, name: str, new_array_text: str) -> str:
    rx = re.compile(
        r"(^[^\S\r\n]*(?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*[a-zA-Z_]\w*(?:\s+[*&]\s*)*\s+"
        + re.escape(name) + r"\s*\[\s*(?:128|0x80)\s*\]\s*=\s*\{.*?\}\s*;)",
        re.S | re.M
    )
    return rx.sub(new_array_text, text, count=1)

def _discover_channel_pairs(text: str) -> List[Tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """
    Findet alle (channel, a_name, t_name) anhand des Namensschemas:
      curvature_<channel>_by_midi  &  attack_time_<channel>_by_midi
    """
    names: List[str] = []
    text_nc = _strip_comments(text)
    rx_all = re.compile(
        r"^[^\S\r\n]*(?:(?:static|constexpr|const)\s+)*[a-zA-Z_]\w*(?:\s+[*&]\s*)*\s+([a-zA-Z_]\w*)\s*\[\s*(?:\d+|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*\]\s*=\s*\{",
        re.S | re.M
    )
    for m in rx_all.finditer(text_nc):
        names.append(m.group(1))
    channels: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
    for nm in names:
        if nm.startswith("curvature_") and nm.endswith("_by_midi"):
            tail = nm[len("curvature_"):-len("_by_midi")]
            channels.setdefault(tail, {})["a"] = nm
        elif nm.startswith("attack_time_") and nm.endswith("_by_midi"):
            tail = nm[len("attack_time_"):-len("_by_midi")]
            channels.setdefault(tail, {})["t"] = nm
    out: List[Tuple[str, str, str]] = []
    for tail, d in channels.items():
        if "a" in d and "t" in d:
            out.append((tail, d["a"], d["t"]))
    return out


# ===================== Smoothing (segmentweise) =======================

def find_segments(valid_mask: np.ndarray) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]:
    idx = np.where(valid_mask.astype(np.int8))[0]
    if idx.size == 0:
        return []
    cuts = np.where(np.diff(idx) > 1)[0]
    starts = np.r_[idx[0], idx[cuts + 1]]
    ends   = np.r_[idx[cuts], idx[-1]] + 1
    return list(zip(starts, ends))

def _hampel_local(x: np.ndarray, k=5, nsig=3.0):
    xo = x.copy()
    n = len(xo)
    for i in range(n):
        i0, i1 = max(0, i - k), min(n, i + k + 1)
        win = xo[i0:i1]
        med = np.median(win)
        mad = np.median(np.abs(win - med)) + 1e-12
        if abs(xo[i] - med) > nsig * 1.4826 * mad:
            xo[i] = 0.5 * xo[i] + 0.5 * med
    return xo

def _replace_outliers_with_neighbors(y: np.ndarray, k: int = 5, nsig: float = 3.0) -> np.ndarray:
    """
    Ersetzt starke Ausreißer durch den Mittelwert der direkten Nachbarn (robust, MAD-basiert).
    Nur innerhalb des übergebenen Segments.
    """
    out = y.copy()
    n = len(out)
    if n == 0:
        return out
    for i in range(n):
        i0, i1 = max(0, i - k), min(n, i + k + 1)
        win = out[i0:i1]
        med = np.median(win)
        mad = np.median(np.abs(win - med)) + 1e-12
        if abs(out[i] - med) > nsig * 1.4826 * mad:
            if 0 < i < n - 1:
                out[i] = 0.5 * (out[i - 1] + out[i + 1])
            elif i > 0:
                out[i] = out[i - 1]
            elif i < n - 1:
                out[i] = out[i + 1]
    return out

def smooth_segmented(y: np.ndarray,
                     valid_mask: np.ndarray,
                     window: int,
                     poly: int,
                     use_savgol: bool = True,
                     pre_hampel: bool = True,
                     outlier_replace: bool = True,
                     outlier_k: int = 5,
                     outlier_nsig: float = 3.0) -> np.ndarray:
    """
    Glättet NUR innerhalb der gültigen Segmente. Ränder/0 bleiben unberührt.
    Optional: Ausreißer durch Nachbar-Mittelwert ersetzen (Standard: an),
              robuste Hampel-Vordämpfung und Savitzky/MA.
    """
    y_out = y.copy()
    segs = find_segments(valid_mask)
    for (s, e) in segs:
        seg = y[s:e].astype(float)
        if not np.any(np.isfinite(seg)):
            continue

        if outlier_replace:
            seg = _replace_outliers_with_neighbors(seg, k=outlier_k, nsig=outlier_nsig)
        if pre_hampel:
            seg = _hampel_local(seg, k=5, nsig=3.0)

        L = len(seg)
        w = window if window % 2 == 1 else window + 1
        w = min(max(5, w), L if L % 2 == 1 else L - 1)
        if w < 5:
            y_out[s:e] = seg
            continue

        if use_savgol:
            try:
                from scipy.signal import savgol_filter  # optional
                seg_sm = savgol_filter(seg, window_length=w,
                                       polyorder=min(poly, w - 1),
                                       mode="interp")
            except Exception:
                seg_sm = _moving_average(seg, w)
        else:
            seg_sm = _moving_average(seg, w)

        y_out[s:e] = seg_sm

    return y_out

def _moving_average(seg: np.ndarray, w: int):
    r = w // 2
    seg_pad = np.pad(seg, (r, r), mode="edge")
    ker = np.ones(w, dtype=float) / w
    return np.convolve(seg_pad, ker, mode="valid")


# ===================== Core: Recompute per channel =======================

def recompute_channel(a_raw: np.ndarray,
                      t_raw: np.ndarray,
                      win_t: int,
                      win_g0: int,
                      poly_t: int,
                      poly_g0: int,
                      strict_zero_a: bool,
                      use_savgol: bool,
                      no_hampel: bool,
                      outlier_replace: bool,
                      outlier_k: int,
                      outlier_nsig: float) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    valid = (t_raw > 0.0)
    if strict_zero_a:
        valid &= (a_raw != 0.0)

    t_sm = smooth_segmented(
        t_raw, valid, window=win_t, poly=poly_t,
        use_savgol=use_savgol, pre_hampel=(not no_hampel),
        outlier_replace=outlier_replace, outlier_k=outlier_k, outlier_nsig=outlier_nsig
    )
    t_sm = np.maximum(t_sm, 0.0)

    g0_raw = 1.0 + a_raw * (t_raw ** 2)
    g0_sm = smooth_segmented(
        g0_raw, valid, window=win_g0, poly=poly_g0,
        use_savgol=use_savgol, pre_hampel=(not no_hampel),
        outlier_replace=outlier_replace, outlier_k=outlier_k, outlier_nsig=outlier_nsig
    )
    g0_sm = np.clip(g0_sm, 0.0, 1.0)

    a_new = np.zeros_like(a_raw, dtype=float)
    t2 = t_sm ** 2
    nz = t2 > 0.0
    a_new[nz] = (g0_sm[nz] - 1.0) / t2[nz]
    return a_new, t_sm, g0_raw, g0_sm


# ===================== Plots =======================

def maybe_make_dirs(path: str | None):
    if path and path.strip():
        os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)

def save_plots(outdir: str,
               channel: str,
               a_raw: np.ndarray, a_new: np.ndarray,
               t_raw: np.ndarray, t_sm: np.ndarray,
               g0_raw: np.ndarray, g0_sm: np.ndarray):
    try:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # optional
    except Exception:
        print(f"[INFO] matplotlib nicht verfügbar – Plots für '{channel}' werden übersprungen.")
        return
    d = os.path.join(outdir, channel) if outdir else ""
    if d:
        maybe_make_dirs(d)
    x = np.arange(128)

    # t
    plt.figure()
    plt.title(f"{channel}: attack_time_by_midi")
    plt.plot(x, t_raw, label="t_raw")
    plt.plot(x, t_sm, label="t_sm")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("t [s]")
    plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout()
    if d: plt.savefig(os.path.join(d, "t_attack.png"), dpi=150)
    plt.close()

    # g0
    plt.figure()
    plt.title(f"{channel}: g0 = 1 + a*t^2")
    plt.plot(x, g0_raw, label="g0_raw")
    plt.plot(x, g0_sm, label="g0_sm (smoothed, clamped)")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("g0 [–]")
    plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout()
    if d: plt.savefig(os.path.join(d, "g0.png"), dpi=150)
    plt.close()

    # a
    plt.figure()
    plt.title(f"{channel}: curvature_by_midi")
    plt.plot(x, a_raw, label="a_raw")
    plt.plot(x, a_new, label="a_new")
    plt.xlabel("MIDI Note"); plt.ylabel("a [1/s^2]")
    plt.legend(); plt.grid(True, linestyle=":")
    plt.tight_layout()
    if d: plt.savefig(os.path.join(d, "a_curvature.png"), dpi=150)
    plt.close()


# ===================== Main =======================

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="One‑Shot: segmentiertes Glätten für alle <channel>-Paare in GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp")
    ap.add_argument("--input", "-i", required=True, help="Pfad zur C++‑Datei mit den Arrays")

    ap.add_argument("--plots", default="", help="Ordner für Plots (optional; pro Kanal Unterordner)")

    args = ap.parse_args()

    in_path = args.input

```python
def _replace_outliers_with_neighbors(y: np.ndarray, k: int = 5, nsig: float = 3.0) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """
    Ersetzt starke Ausreißer durch den Mittelwert der direkten Nachbarn (MAD-basiert).
    Gibt (geglättetes_segment, bool_maske_ersetzt) zurück.
    """
    out = y.copy()
    n = len(out)
    replaced = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
    if n == 0:
        return out, replaced
    for i in range(n):
        i0, i1 = max(0, i - k), min(n, i + k + 1)
        win = out[i0:i1]
        med = np.median(win)
        mad = np.median(np.abs(win - med)) + 1e-12
        if abs(out[i] - med) > nsig * 1.4826 * mad:
            replaced[i] = True
            if 0 < i < n - 1:
                out[i] = 0.5 * (out[i - 1] + out[i + 1])
            elif i > 0:
                out[i] = out[i - 1]
            elif i < n - 1:
                out[i] = out[i + 1]
    return out, replaced
```

stimmt — wenn „a“ direkt geglättet wird, verschießt das die Physik. Korrekt ist: **nur \(g_0\) glätten (und optional \(t_{\max}\)) und dann \(a = \dfrac{g_0-1}{t_{\max}^2}\) neu berechnen.**  
Hier ist ein sauberes, selbstausführendes Skript, das genau das tut und *nur* \(g_0\) und \(t_{\max}\) glättet:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Re-smooth GO attack parameters the right way:
- DO NOT smooth curvature 'a' directly.
- Smooth only g0 (and optionally t_max) and then recompute:
      a_new = (g0_smooth - 1.0) / (tmax_smooth ** 2)

It reads curvature_by_midi[128] and attack_time_by_midi[128] from a C++ file
(GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp-style), derives g0 from the current arrays,
applies a robust (Hampel -> moving average) smoothing to g0 (and t_max if enabled),
recomputes 'a', and writes back updated arrays.

Usage example:
  python fix_go_attack_params_g0_only.py --input "GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp" --out same --win 5 --smooth-tmax
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import argparse, re, math, sys, os
from typing import List, Tuple

ARRAY_RE = re.compile(
    r"const\s+float\s+(?P<name>curvature_by_midi|attack_time_by_midi)\s*\[\s*128\s*\]\s*=\s*\{(?P<body>.*?)\};",
    re.S
)

def parse_arrays(text: str) -> Tuple[List[float], List[float], Tuple[int,int]]:
    """Return (a_list, t_list, (a_span_start, a_span_end)) with source spans for in-place replace."""
    a_match = None
    t_match = None
    for m in ARRAY_RE.finditer(text):
        name, body = m.group("name"), m.group("body")
        vals = [float(v) for v in re.findall(r"[-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?", body)]
        if len(vals) != 128:
            raise ValueError(f"{name}: erwartet 128 Werte, gefunden {len(vals)}")
        if name == "curvature_by_midi":
            a_match = (vals, m.start("body"), m.end("body"))
        else:
            t_match = (vals, m.start("body"), m.end("body"))
    if not a_match or not t_match:
        raise ValueError("Arrays 'curvature_by_midi' oder 'attack_time_by_midi' nicht gefunden.")
    return a_match[0], t_match[0], (a_match[1], a_match[2], t_match[1], t_match[2])

def hampel_filter(x: List[float], k: int = 3, n_sigmas: float = 3.0) -> List[float]:
    """Simple Hampel filter (median ± n_sigmas * 1.4826*MAD)."""
    if k < 1:
        return x[:]
    from statistics import median
    y = x[:]
    n = len(x)
    for i in range(n):
        i0 = max(0, i - k)
        i1 = min(n, i + k + 1)
        window = x[i0:i1]
        med = median(window)
        mad = median([abs(v - med) for v in window]) if len(window) > 1 else 0.0
        sigma = 1.4826 * mad
        if sigma == 0:
            continue
        if abs(x[i] - med) > n_sigmas * sigma:
            y[i] = med
    return y

def moving_average(x: List[float], win: int) -> List[float]:
    if win <= 1:
        return x[:]
    n = len(x)
    y = [0.0]*n
    s = 0.0
    w = win
    # symmetric window with reflection at edges
    def get(j: int) -> float:
        if j < 0:  j = -j
        if j >= n:
            j = 2*n - 2 - j if j <= 2*n-2 else (j % (2*n-2))
        return x[j]
    # initialize first window
    for j in range(-(w//2), w//2 + 1):
        s += get(j)
    y[0] = s / w
    # slide
    for i in range(1, n):
        s += get(i + (w//2)) - get(i - 1 - (w//2))
        y[i] = s / w
    return y

def derive_g0_from_a_t(a: List[float], t: List[float]) -> List[float]:
    """g0 = 1 + a * t^2  (since y(0) = 1 + a*(0 - tmax)^2)."""
    g0 = []
    for ai, ti in zip(a, t):
        g0.append(1.0 + ai*(ti**2))
    return g0

def recompute_a(g0: List[float], t: List[float]) -> List[float]:
    out = []
    for g, ti in zip(g0, t):
        if ti <= 0:
            out.append(0.0)  # safe fallback
        else:
            out.append((g - 1.0) / (ti*ti))
    return out

def format_array(vals: List[float], per_line: int = 8, prec: int = 8) -> str:
    chunks = []
    line = []
    for i, v in enumerate(vals):
        line.append(f"{v:.{prec}f}")
        if (i+1) % per_line == 0:
            chunks.append(", ".join(line))
            line = []
    if line:
        chunks.append(", ".join(line))
    return (",\n  ".join(chunks))

def process(
    text: str,
    win_g0: int,
    win_t: int,
    do_smooth_t: bool,
    hampel_k: int,
    hampel_sigmas: float,
) -> str:
    a, t, spans = parse_arrays(text)
    g0 = derive_g0_from_a_t(a, t)

    # Robust smoothing: Hampel (outlier repair) -> moving average
    g0_h = hampel_filter(g0, k=hampel_k, n_sigmas=hampel_sigmas) if hampel_k > 0 else g0
    g0_s = moving_average(g0_h, win_g0) if win_g0 > 1 else g0_h

    if do_smooth_t:
        t_h = hampel_filter(t, k=hampel_k, n_sigmas=hampel_sigmas) if hampel_k > 0 else t
        t_s = moving_average(t_h, win_t) if win_t > 1 else t_h
    else:
        t_s = t

    a_new = recompute_a(g0_s, t_s)

    # write back arrays (only curvature_by_midi and attack_time_by_midi)
    a_body = format_array(a_new)
    t_body = format_array(t_s)

    a_start, a_end, t_start, t_end = spans
    # replace from end to start to keep indices valid
    out = text
    out = out[:t_start] + t_body + out[t_end:]
    out = out[:a_start] + a_body + out[a_end:]
    return out

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Smooth g0 (and optional t_max) and recompute curvature a.")
    ap.add_argument("--input", required=True, help="Pfad zu GO_Attack_Parameters.cpp")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="same", help="'same' (in-place) oder Ausgabedatei")
    ap.add_argument("--win", type=int, default=5, help="Moving-Average Fensterbreite für g0 (odd >=1).")
    ap.add_argument("--win-t", type=int, default=3, help="Moving-Average Fensterbreite für t_max (odd >=1).")
    ap.add_argument("--smooth-tmax", action="store_true", help="Auch t_max glätten (empfohlen, aber optional).")
    ap.add_argument("--hampel-k", type=int, default=3, help="Hampel-Halbfenster k (0 = aus).")
    ap.add_argument("--hampel-sigmas", type=float, default=3.0, help="Hampel-Threshold in Sigma.")
    ap.add_argument("--prec", type=int, default=8, help="Nachkommastellen beim Schreiben.")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    if args.win < 1 or args.win % 2 == 0:
        print("⚠️  --win sollte eine ungerade Zahl >=1 sein. Ich erhöhe ggf. um 1.")
        if args.win < 1: args.win = 1
        if args.win % 2 == 0: args.win += 1
    if args.win_t < 1 or args.win_t % 2 == 0:
        if args.smooth_tmax:
            print("⚠️  --win-t sollte eine ungerade Zahl >=1 sein. Ich erhöhe ggf. um 1.")
        if args.win_t < 1: args.win_t = 1
        if args.win_t % 2 == 0: args.win_t += 1

    with open(args.input, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        text = f.read()

    out_text = process(
        text=text,
        win_g0=args.win,
        win_t=args.win_t,
        do_smooth_t=args.smooth_tmax,
        hampel_k=args.hampel_k,
        hampel_sigmas=args.hampel_sigmas,
    )

    # precision control by re-format after process
    def reformat_prec(m):
        name = m.group("name")
        body_vals = [float(v) for v in re.findall(r"[-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?", m.group("body"))]
        body = format_array(body_vals, prec=args.prec)
        return f"const float {name}[128] = {{\n  {body}\n}};"

    out_text = ARRAY_RE.sub(reformat_prec, out_text)

    if args.out == "same":
        out_path = args.input
    else:
        out_path = args.out
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(out_text)
    print(f"✅ Fertig: {out_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
